hvac.moist_air_mixing.title: Adiabatic mixing of two moist-air streams

variables.name: H3
variables.desc: mixed enthalpy per kg dry air

procedure.python:
def _moist_air_mixing(values):
    """Adiabatic mixing of two moist-air streams by humidity-ratio and enthalpy balance."""
    m1, T1, RH1 = values['m1'], values['T1'], values['RH1']
    m2, T2, RH2 = values['m2'], values['T2'], values['RH2']
    P = values['P']
    if m1 <= 0 or m2 <= 0:
        raise MechError('stream mass flows must be positive')
    W1 = common.humid_air('W', T=T1, R=RH1, P=P)
    H1 = common.humid_air('H', T=T1, R=RH1, P=P)
    W2 = common.humid_air('W', T=T2, R=RH2, P=P)
    H2 = common.humid_air('H', T=T2, R=RH2, P=P)
    W3 = (m1 * W1 + m2 * W2) / (m1 + m2)
    H3 = (m1 * H1 + m2 * H2) / (m1 + m2)
    T3 = common.humid_air('T', W=W3, H=H3, P=P)
    RH3 = common.humid_air('R', W=W3, H=H3, P=P)
    return {'W3': W3, 'H3': H3, 'T3': T3, 'RH3': RH3}

assumptions: Adiabatic mixing; the mixed state lies on the straight line between the two states in the H–W plane (mass-weighted humidity-ratio and enthalpy balances).
method_references: Mixing: W3 = Σ(m W)/Σm; H3 = Σ(m H)/Σm

hvac.sensible_process.title: Sensible heating / cooling of moist air (constant W)

variables.name: H1
variables.desc: inlet enthalpy per kg dry air

variables.name: H2
variables.desc: outlet enthalpy per kg dry air

assumptions: Constant humidity ratio W; covers both heating (T2 > T1, Q > 0) and sensible cooling above the dew point (T2 > T_dp).
method_references: Q = m_da (H2 − H1) at constant W

hvac.adiabatic_humidification.title: Adiabatic humidification / evaporative cooling (constant enthalpy)

variables.name: H
variables.desc: constant enthalpy per kg dry air

procedure.python:
def _adiabatic_humidification(values):
    """Adiabatic (evaporative) humidification: constant enthalpy, water sprayed in.

    Outlet humidity ratio W2 = W1 + m_w/m_da at H2 = H1; the outlet temperature follows the wet-bulb
    (constant-enthalpy) line toward saturation.
    """
    m_da, T1, RH1 = values['m_da'], values['T1'], values['RH1']
    m_w, P = values['m_w'], values['P']
    if m_da <= 0 or m_w <= 0:
        raise MechError('m_da and m_w must be positive')
    W1 = common.humid_air('W', T=T1, R=RH1, P=P)
    H = common.humid_air('H', T=T1, R=RH1, P=P)
    W2 = W1 + m_w / m_da
    try:
        T2 = common.humid_air('T', W=W2, H=H, P=P)
        RH2 = common.humid_air('R', W=W2, H=H, P=P)
    except MechError:
        raise MechError(f'outlet humidity ratio W2 = {W2:.5f} exceeds saturation at the constant-enthalpy '
                        'state: the sprayed water cannot all be absorbed; reduce m_w or use '
                        'cooling_dehumidification for moisture removal')
    if RH2 > 1.0:
        raise MechError(f'outlet state is supersaturated (RH = {RH2:.3f}): reduce the water spray rate m_w '
                        'so W2 stays below saturation')
    return {'T2': T2, 'W1': W1, 'W2': W2, 'RH2': RH2, 'H': H}

assumptions: No external heat: the outlet state follows the constant-enthalpy line toward saturation (limits at the thermodynamic wet-bulb temperature). W2 must stay below saturation.
method_references: Adiabatic humidification: H = const, W2 = W1 + m_w/m_da

hvac.cooling_dehumidification.title: Cooling and dehumidification of moist air

variables.name: Q_dot
variables.desc: total coil cooling load (negative of the air-side heat loss)

variables.name: H1
variables.desc: inlet enthalpy per kg dry air

variables.name: H2
variables.desc: outlet enthalpy per kg dry air

procedure.python:
def _cooling_dehumidification(values):
    """Cooling and dehumidification: air leaves saturated at T2 (below the inlet dew point).

    Condensate m_cond = m_da (W1 − W2) leaves at T2; coil load
    Q = m_da (H1 − H2) − m_cond c_pw (T2 − 273.15 K).
    """
    m_da, T1, RH1 = values['m_da'], values['T1'], values['RH1']
    T2, P = values['T2'], values['P']
    W1 = common.humid_air('W', T=T1, R=RH1, P=P)
    H1 = common.humid_air('H', T=T1, R=RH1, P=P)
    W2 = common.humid_air('W', T=T2, R=1.0, P=P)
    if W2 >= W1:
        raise MechError('T2 is not below the inlet dew point (no condensation)')
    H2 = common.humid_air('H', T=T2, R=1.0, P=P)
    m_cond = m_da * (W1 - W2)
    Q = m_da * (H1 - H2) - m_cond * CP_WATER * (T2 - 273.15)
    return {'Q_dot': Q, 'm_cond': m_cond, 'W1': W1, 'W2': W2, 'RH2': 1.0, 'H1': H1, 'H2': H2}

assumptions: Air leaves saturated at T2, which must be below the inlet dew point; condensate leaves at T2 (enthalpy c_pw (T2 − 273.15 K)). Reheat to the supply condition is a separate sensible_process.
method_references: Q = m_da(H1 − H2) − m_cond c_pw (T2 − 0 °C); m_cond = m_da (W1 − W2)

hvac.cooling_tower_range_approach.title: Cooling tower range and approach
assumptions: Approach is the practical lower limit set by the ambient wet-bulb temperature.

hvac.cooling_tower_makeup.title: Cooling tower makeup water (evaporation, blowdown, drift)
assumptions: Evaporation removes the heat (E = Q/h_fg) and carries no dissolved solids; blowdown and drift together carry the solids away, so B + D = E/(n − 1) and M = E + B + D = E·n/(n − 1). Drift fraction is a tower-design input.
method_references: Cooling-tower water balance M = E + B + D; solids balance B + D = E/(n − 1)

hvac.conduction_load.title: Conduction (envelope) heating/cooling load (Q = U A ΔT)
assumptions: Use U from the overall-U calculator; dT = T_indoor − T_outdoor (heating positive, cooling negative).

hvac.air_infiltration.title: Infiltration / ventilation sensible and latent loads
assumptions: Standard air ρ ≈ 1.2 kg/m³, c_p ≈ 1005 J/(kg·K); latent heat uses the water value h_fg ≈ 2.5 MJ/kg. dT and dW are signed (humidification/dehumidification change the sign of Q_lat).
method_references: Q_sens = ρ c_p Q dT; Q_lat = ρ h_fg Q dW

hvac.air_changes_per_hour.title: Air changes per hour and the corresponding volumetric flow
assumptions: Q is the supply/outdoor flow giving the stated air-change rate.

hvac.ventilation_rate.title: Required outdoor-air (ventilation) rate (ASHRAE 62.1 form)
assumptions: Rp and Ra are the ASHRAE 62.1 breathing-zone rates for the occupancy category (user inputs, standard table).

hvac.sensible_heat_ratio.title: Sensible heat ratio (SHR = Q_sens/(Q_sens + Q_lat))
assumptions: Defines the slope of the room condition line on the psychrometric chart.

hvac.apparatus_dew_point.title: Apparatus dew point (coil ADP) from room condition and SHR

variables.name: W_adp
variables.desc: humidity ratio at the apparatus dew point

assumptions: ADP is where the room condition line (slope from SHR) meets saturation; it always lies below the room dew point. Coil sizing uses the ADP with the bypass factor.

hvac.total_space_load.title: Total space cooling/heating load (sum of components)
assumptions: Solar heat gain factors and CLTD values are user inputs (standard tables), folded into Q_solar/Q_cond.
method_references: Space load = Σ (conduction + infiltration + solar + internal gains)

hvac.rectangular_duct_equivalent.title: Circular equivalent diameter of a rectangular duct (Huebscher)
assumptions: Huebscher equivalent diameter for equal friction at the same flow (aspect ratios below ~8).

hvac.fan_power.title: Fan air power and shaft power
assumptions: dp is the fan TOTAL pressure rise (static + velocity pressure across the fan); decompose it with turbomachinery.fan_total_pressure. η = fan total efficiency.

hvac.hydronic_capacity.title: Hydronic heating/cooling capacity (Q = ṁ c_p ΔT)

variables.name: Q
variables.desc: heat rate delivered to/from the water (heating +, cooling −)

assumptions: One relation for both chilled-water (cooling, Q < 0 in the heating sign convention) and hot-water (heating) loops; dT ≈ 5–7 K for chilled water, 10–20 K for hot water; c_p ≈ 4186 J/(kg·K).
